en.hubeali: H 14585 – And by this chain, who has narrated the following: Imamasws said: ‘Amir-ul-Momineenasws said: ‘
The one who exposes himself for the accusation, so he should not blame the one who thinks bad about him, and the one who conceals his secret, would have the good in his hands (is secure from that)’.
en.sarwar: 137. And by this chain, who has narrated the following: Imam (a.s.) said: ‘Amir-ul-Momineen (a.s.) said: ‘
The one who exposes himself for the accusation, so he should not blame the one who thinks bad about him, and the one who conceals his secret, would have the good in his hands (is secure from that)’.
